# The route render and the static render have to agree on a prop's shape. The
# guard that stopped the route render dropping a prop it could not express only
# accepted a *string* literal, and `element` declares `rows`, `width` and
# `height` as ints -- so a numeric attribute the static render emits aborted the
# route build outright.

sngl generate --lang go --platform html --out route route.sngl
grep 'rows=\\"4\\"' route/server.go
grep 'width=\\"100\\"' route/server.go
grep 'height=\\"50\\"' route/server.go

# The same program, same attributes, on the static path.
sngl generate --lang none --platform html --out static static.sngl
grep 'rows="4"' static/index.html
grep 'width="100"' static/index.html
grep 'height="50"' static/index.html

-- route.sngl --
import . "sngl://std"
import "sngl://platforms/html"

output {
    go { html }
}

component main {
    var n string = ""
    window {
        textarea(:value=n, rows=4)
        html.img(src="a.png", width=100, height=50) {}
    }
}
-- static.sngl --
import . "sngl://std"
import "sngl://platforms/html"

component main {
    var n string = ""
    window {
        textarea(:value=n, rows=4)
        html.img(src="a.png", width=100, height=50) {}
    }
}
